reels.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta

editorial_notes.reasoning: Meta's Muse Spark Open leverages the high-velocity 'multimodal_diffusion' domain. It offers immense visual potential for 3b1b-style animations showing how mixture-of-experts models 'switch' routes to process data, ideal for explaining complex model architectures.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How does Meta's new AI model 'think' across images, text, and audio without burning through all its computing power at once?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A traffic controller at a busy intersection who only opens the lanes (experts) needed for a specific vehicle type, rather than keeping the entire highway open.
